title: Channel
description: A link to somewhere the community gathers away from this site: a Discord, a subreddit, a funding page. These are content rather than code so that they can be changed without a developer, which matters for a project whose leadership is expected to change hands.

platform.description: Which service this link goes to. This decides the icon and the label on the button, and which web addresses the link is allowed to use: a Discord link has to point at Discord. Adding a service to this list is a code change.

group.description: Which column this appears under on the front page. A column with nothing enabled in it is not drawn at all, so the site simply has no Support column rather than an empty one.

url.description: Where the link goes. Must start with https, and must match the service chosen above, or the site will not show it.

blurb.description: The paragraph above this column. Shown as plain text, so formatting marks would appear as characters.

order.description: Where this sits within its column.

enabled.description: Untick to hide this link without deleting it. Use this rather than deleting when a link might come back.
